What are the best weapons at each power level in RuneScape: Dragonwilds? Here are my picks from Power Level 1 to 9, covering one-handed and two-handed melee, ranged weapons and magic.

I’ve used these weapons in combat and looked at more than the damage number: combos, special attacks, perks, stamina costs and how useful each weapon feels when you actually reach that stage of the game. From the Stone Dagger and Skullsplitter to the Zombie Axe, Dorgeshuun Crossbow and the current Power Level 9 weapons, this is the weapon progression I’d recommend.

These are my picks for weapons introduced at each power level. An upgraded weapon from an earlier level may still be your best option.
